name: Investigación Filosófica AI-assisted silver judge v1

policy.relevance: NLI supplies the graded 0-3 silver relevance label. The reranker remains an independent retrieval signal used only for disagreement auditing.
policy.discipline: NLI classifies whether the document is primarily non-philosophical, interdisciplinary, or philosophy scholarship.
policy.role: Documentary role is auxiliary metadata. Low-confidence role predictions become UNSURE but do not by themselves force human review.
policy.humanReview: needs_human_review is reserved for critical uncertainty in benchmark-driving relevance/discipline labels or strong NLI-reranker disagreement. Missing abstracts and role uncertainty remain audit reasons but are not sufficient on their own.
